scope: Finite known-candidate noisy Gaussian discrimination pilot, not a new design method or nonlinear warning algorithm
information: Candidate models, noise variance and covariance formulas known; true label withheld. Independent stationary position pairs, not overlapping pairs from one trajectory.
design_rule: Choose lags before simulation using either minimum pairwise absolute covariance difference or minimum pairwise Gaussian Bhattacharyya distance over the fixed lag grid. Random design draws one lag per dataset, not one per pair.
selection_rule: Maximum Gaussian likelihood, equal model priors; ties within 1e-10 log likelihood select lowest candidate index
confidence_rule: Include j if log(mean_i p_i(data))-log(p_j(data)) <= log(1/alpha); fixed mixture likelihood-ratio test inversion
false_reassurance_rule: Singleton confidence set and selected relative complex susceptibility error above 0.05
uncertainty: Per-cell Wilson 95 percent Monte Carlo intervals for event proportions; no simultaneous or population-transfer claim
comparison: Descriptive performance comparison; no superiority threshold selected after outcomes
misspecification_rule: Run alias 4 without adding it to candidates; label separately and never claim the in-family confidence guarantee applies
